title: Osteoporosis — Exercising Safely to Protect Bones

hook.en: Bones respond to load, even in older age. Learn which exercises build and protect bone, which movements to avoid after a spinal fracture and how to keep a person with osteoporosis strong and confident.
hook.ur: Haddiyan load par react karti hain, buzurgi mein bhi. Seekhein ke kaun si exercises haddi banati aur bachati hain, spine fracture ke baad kin harkaton se bachna hai aur osteoporosis ke mareez ko mazboot aur pur-aitemad kaise rakhna hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain osteoporosis simply, screen for spinal fracture, and prescribe weight-bearing, resistance and balance exercise while avoiding loaded forward bending and twisting.
goal.ur: End tak aap osteoporosis saada alfaz mein samjhayenge, spine fracture ki screening karenge, aur wazan uthane wali, resistance aur balance exercise dein ge jabke loaded aage jhukne aur ghoomne se bachayenge.

text.en: **Osteoporosis** is low bone density with weaker bone structure, so bones break from small forces, such as a fall from standing or even a cough. It is often silent until the first fracture. The aim of exercise is two-fold: **strengthen bone** with load and **prevent the falls** that break it. Most people with osteoporosis should exercise, with a few important changes.
text.ur: **Osteoporosis** mein haddi ki density kam aur dhaancha kamzor hota hai, is liye chhoti taaqat se haddi toot jati hai, maslan khare hone ki halat se girna ya khansi se bhi. Yeh aksar pehle fracture tak khamosh rehta hai. Exercise ke do maqsad hain: load se **haddi mazboot karna** aur woh **girna rokna** jo haddi tora hai. Zyada tar osteoporosis ke mareezon ko exercise karni chahiye, kuch ahem tabdeeliyon ke saath.

text.en: Think of bone as a **muscle for the skeleton**: it grows stronger where it is regularly and sensibly loaded, and thins where it is not. A sensible load is like a gym programme for the bone, firm enough to signal "build here", but never so sudden or twisting that it breaks.
text.ur: Haddi ko **skeleton ka muscle** samjhein: jahan baqaida aur samajhdari se load pare wahan mazboot hoti hai, aur jahan na pare wahan patli. Munasib load haddi ke liye gym programme ki tarah hai, itna mazboot ke "yahan banao" ka ishara de, magar kabhi itna achanak ya ghoomne wala nahi ke tor de.

steps.title: Ask about fractures and pain
steps.detail: Ask about previous fractures, height loss, a stooped back and sudden back pain. New sudden mid-back pain after a minor strain can be a vertebral fracture and needs medical review before exercise. || Fractures aur dard ke baare mein poochhein

steps.title: Build the bone load
steps.detail: Prescribe weight-bearing exercise (brisk walking, stair climbing, safe light impact if suitable) and progressive resistance training for the legs, hips, back and arms, several times a week. || Haddi par load barhayein

steps.title: Add balance and posture
steps.detail: Include balance practice to reduce falls and back extensor strength with posture work. Teach a hip hinge for bending and lifting, keeping the spine neutral. || Balance aur posture shamil karein

steps.title: Avoid the risky movements
steps.detail: Avoid loaded forward bending, twisting under load, sit-ups and high-impact or contact activity if the spine is fragile. Review medicines and calcium and vitamin D with the doctor. || Khatarnak harkaton se bachein

question.en: Which movement should be avoided after a vertebral fracture?
question.ur: Vertebral fracture ke baad kaun si harkat se bachna chahiye?

text.en: Loaded forward bending, such as touching the toes while lifting or doing sit-ups
text.ur: Loaded aage jhukna, maslan wazan uthate waqt ungliyan chhoona ya sit-ups

feedback.en: Yes — forward bending under load compresses the front of the vertebrae.
feedback.ur: Haan — load ke saath aage jhukna vertebrae ke agle hisse ko dabata hai.
Yeh girne ka khatra kam karti hai.
Chalna haddi par mehfooz load daalta hai.

title.en: Safe or risky exercise for fragile bones?
title.ur: Kamzor haddiyon ke liye mehfooz ya khatarnak exercise?

headers.ur: Aam taur par mehfooz aur mufeed
Aam taur par bachayi ya badli jati hai

rows.en: Hip hinge with a neutral spine, back extension in standing
rows.ur: Neutral spine ke saath hip hinge, khare ho kar back extension

rows.en: Loaded forward bending, sit-ups, twisting under load
rows.ur: Loaded aage jhukna, sit-ups, load ke saath ghoomna

rows.en: Contact sport, high-impact jumping if the spine is fragile
rows.ur: Contact khel, kamzor spine mein zyada impact wali chhalangein

rows.en: Progressive legs, hips, arms and back with good form
rows.ur: Taangon, kulhon, bazuon aur peeth ki darje war, sahi form ke saath

rows.en: Heavy lifts with a rounded back
rows.ur: Gol peeth ke saath bhari wazan

rows.en: Narrow-stance and heel-to-toe practice near support
rows.ur: Sahare ke qareeb tang stance aur heel-to-toe

rows.en: Balance work with no support in a high-risk person
rows.ur: Zyada khatre wale shakhs mein bina sahare balance kaam

text.en: **Load the bone, spare the spine.** Walk, stand tall, lift with a hip hinge and challenge balance, but do not bend forward under load or twist hard.
text.ur: **Haddi par load, spine ko aaram.** Chalein, seedha khare hon, hip hinge se uthayein aur balance ko challenge dein, magar load ke saath aage na jhukein aur zor se na ghoomein.

text.en: **Telling a person with osteoporosis to stop exercising.** Inactivity weakens bone and muscle and increases the risk of falls and fractures. Fear is the real danger. Explain which exercises are safe and teach them with confidence.
text.ur: **Osteoporosis ke mareez ko exercise rokne ko kehna.** Be-harkati haddi aur muscle kamzor karti hai aur girne aur fracture ka khatra barhati hai. Asal khatra dar hai. Samjhayein ke kaun si exercises mehfooz hain aur aitemad ke saath sikhayein.

question.en: What should happen before exercise for a person with sudden new mid-back pain after a small strain?
question.ur: Chhoti kheench ke baad achanak nayi darmiyani peeth ke dard wale shakhs ke liye exercise se pehle kya hona chahiye?

feedback.ur: Aaram haddi ko mazeed kamzor karta hai.
Yeh fracture ko bigaad sakti hai.

text.en: Medical review for a possible vertebral fracture
text.ur: Mumkin vertebral fracture ke liye medical review

feedback.en: Yes — a vertebral fracture must be confirmed and managed before loading the spine.
feedback.ur: Haan — spine par load se pehle vertebral fracture ki tasdeeq aur ilaaj zaroori hai.

question.en: Which exercise helps bone and also lowers the risk of falling?
question.ur: Kaun si exercise haddi ke liye bhi mufeed hai aur girne ka khatra bhi kam karti hai?

text.en: Sit-ups and toe touches with a rounded back
text.ur: Sit-ups aur gol peeth ke saath ungliyan chhoona

feedback.en: These load the front of the vertebrae and are avoided.
feedback.ur: Yeh vertebrae ke agle hisse par load daalte hain aur inse bacha jata hai.

text.en: Brisk walking, sit-to-stand and balance practice done regularly
text.ur: Tez chalna, sit-to-stand aur balance practice jo baqaida ki jaye

feedback.en: Yes — load builds bone and balance with leg strength prevents falls.
feedback.ur: Haan — load haddi banata hai aur balance taangon ki taaqat ke saath girna rokta hai.
Aaram haddi aur muscle kamzor karta hai.

text.en: **Think of three jobs: bone, muscle, balance.** Each week include some impact or weight-bearing work, some resistance training and some balance practice. Teach correct lifting and bending for daily life, and make sure the person is also taking calcium, vitamin D and any prescribed medicine, as advised by the doctor.
text.ur: **Teen kaam sochein: haddi, muscle, balance.** Har haftay thora impact ya wazan uthane wala kaam, thori resistance training aur thori balance practice shamil karein. Rozmarra ke liye sahi uthana aur jhukna sikhayein, aur yaqeeni banayein ke shakhs doctor ke mashware se calcium, vitamin D aur koi tajweez shuda dawai bhi le raha hai.

question.en: Why does bone respond to exercise?
question.ur: Haddi exercise par react kyun karti hai?

answer.en: Bone cells sense the strain that muscles and body weight place on bone. A regular, adequate load signals the bone to add and reorganise tissue and so become stronger, while a lack of load tells it to thin. This is why impact and resistance training help, and why loading must be sensible and progressive.
answer.ur: Haddi ke cells us khichao ko mehsoos karte hain jo muscles aur jism ka wazan haddi par daalta hai. Baqaida, munasib load haddi ko ishara deta hai ke tissue shamil kare aur dobara tarteeb de aur mazboot ho, jabke load ki kami patla hone ka ishara deti hai. Isi liye impact aur resistance training madad karti hain, aur load munasib aur darje war hona chahiye.

beats.patient: A 68-year-old woman with osteoporosis on her scan, no previous fracture, has become afraid to exercise after her sister broke a wrist. She walks little and has weak legs.
beats.assessment: Her main risks are low activity, weak legs and fear; she has no fracture or back-pain red flags.
beats.treatment: Start with a short daily walk, progressive leg and back strengthening with a hip hinge, balance practice near a counter and a review of calcium and vitamin D with her doctor.
beats.reassess: After three months she walks twenty minutes daily, her chair stands improve and she has no fear of exercising.

text.en: **Seek medical review** for sudden new back pain after a minor strain or a cough, new height loss, a fall with severe pain or deformity, pain at night or at rest that is not mechanical, unexplained weight loss, or new weakness or numbness in the legs. After a fracture follow the surgeon's advice before loading the area.
text.ur: **Medical review karwayein** maamooli kheench ya khansi ke baad achanak nayi peeth ka dard, qad mein nayi kami, girne ke baad shadeed dard ya bad-shakli, raat ko ya aaram mein dard jo mechanical na ho, be-wajah wazan ka girna, ya taangon mein nayi kamzori ya sunn hona. Fracture ke baad hissay par load se pehle surgeon ka mashwara maanein.

summary.en: Osteoporosis weakens bone so small forces can break it; exercise strengthens bone with load and prevents the falls that cause fractures.
summary.ur: Osteoporosis haddi kamzor karta hai is liye chhoti taaqat se bhi toot sakti hai; exercise load se haddi mazboot karti hai aur girna rokti hai jo fracture karta hai.

summary.en: Prescribe weight-bearing, progressive resistance and balance exercise; teach a hip hinge and avoid loaded forward bending and twisting.
summary.ur: Wazan uthane wali, darje war resistance aur balance exercise dein; hip hinge sikhayein aur loaded aage jhukne aur ghoomne se bachein.

summary.en: Screen for vertebral fracture with new sudden back pain; do not tell patients to stop exercising, as fear and inactivity are the real danger.
summary.ur: Naye achanak peeth ke dard se vertebral fracture ki screening karein; mareezon ko exercise rokne ko na kahein, kyunke dar aur be-harkati asal khatra hain.

back.en: Regular loading signals bone to build and reorganise tissue.
back.ur: Baqaida loading haddi ko tissue banane aur dobara tarteeb dene ka ishara deti hai.

back.en: Loaded forward bending, such as sit-ups or lifting with a rounded back.
back.ur: Loaded aage jhukna, maslan sit-ups ya gol peeth se uthana.

front.en: Name the three jobs of osteoporosis exercise.
front.ur: Osteoporosis exercise ke teen kaam batayein.

back.en: Load the bone, strengthen muscle and train balance.
back.ur: Haddi par load, muscle ki taaqat aur balance ki training.

front.en: What is the safe way to bend and lift?
front.ur: Jhukne aur uthane ka mehfooz tareeqa kya hai?

back.en: A hip hinge with a neutral spine.
back.ur: Neutral spine ke saath hip hinge.
